entries.label: CO  42  Stripes Feet Female

tags.subject: animal-stripe banding
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles and toes

entries.description: Dense parallel zebra-stripe brushstrokes wrap the top of each foot, the ankle and the toes, with the heaviest banding running across the instep. The strokes follow the foot's contour like fur, leaving the soles mostly clear.

entries.label: CO  32  Dalish Feet  1  Female

tags.subject: dotted tribal vines with curl accents
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles and the inner arch

entries.description: A network of stippled dotted vines runs over the top of each foot and curls around the ankle, with paired hook-spirals scattered along the inner arch and outer toe-line. The pattern reads as Dalish foliage stencilled in dots rather than solid ink.

entries.label: CO  33  Dalish Feet  2  Female

tags.subject: stippled vines with leaf-and-branch cluster
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles, and a central branch over the upper instep

entries.description: A dense leaf-and-branch motif rises from the upper instep of each foot, framed by stacked horizontal dotted-vine bands that wrap the ankle and the toes. Tiny dotted curls and short hatch dashes accent the outer foot edges.

entries.label: CO  36  Corruption Foot Base Female

tags.subject: ragged ink overgrowth
tags.style: solid ink with torn organic edges
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles and shins

entries.description: A solid-fill creeping mass of ink covers the top of each foot, climbs the ankle and continues onto the lower shin with shredded, torn edges. The shape reads as a corrupting blot devouring the foot rather than a contained tattoo.

entries.label: CO  36  Corruption Foot L 2  Female

tags.subject: demonic glyph row
tags.placement: outer ankle and outer side of both feet

entries.description: Scattered columns of small angular runes run down the outer ankle of each foot and curl across the outer instep, looking like a short cursed inscription. The toes and the top centre of the foot stay clear.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Feet Base Female

tags.subject: flame-like ink overgrowth around a sun-disc
tags.style: solid ink with torn flame edges
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles and the central instep

entries.description: A heavy solid-ink fill wraps the top of each foot and meets at a small sun-disc glyph on the central instep, with torn flame-like edges that ripple outward. Drips trail up onto the lower shin.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Feet L 2  Female

tags.subject: broken ink fragments with hooked claws
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles and the central instep

entries.description: The Base ink-mass broken up into solid black shards with claw-tipped extensions, still arranged around the central sun-disc on the instep. The fragments scatter across the foot top and the lower ankle.

entries.label: CO  43  Natura Feet L 3  Female

tags.subject: etched runic and fern detailing
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles and the central instep around a sun-disc

entries.description: A delicate stipple overlay of tiny fern fronds, dotted runes, leaf clusters and hatch bars tracing the same outline as the heavier tier, gathered around a central sun-disc on the instep. Reads as a fine etched continuation of the ink mass.

entries.id: CO 43 Natura Feet L3 Variant Female
entries.label: CO  43  Natura Feet L 3  Variant Female

layers.texture: Actors\Character\Overlays\Community Overlays\CO 2\43 Body L3 Variant F.dds

tags.subject: etched runic and fern detailing, sparser variant
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles and the central instep

entries.description: A sparser fine-stipple overlay along the same outline, with the dotted fern fronds and hatch bars more thinly spread and the central sun-disc accent removed. The remaining marks read as a faded etched continuation of the heavier tier.

entries.label: CO  38  Mitsukami Feet Female

tags.subject: scattered swirl-and-eye sigils
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles, toes and inner arch

entries.description: Multiple paired sigils — flat spirals fed by short tendrils, plus a stylised slit-eye inside a horseshoe — scatter across the top of each foot, the ankle and the inner arch. Each glyph sits as its own small mark rather than connecting into a band.

entries.label: CO  39  Runic Shade Feet Female

tags.subject: dense runic inscription
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles and toes

entries.description: A dense field of small angular runes blankets the top of each foot, wraps the ankle and continues over the toes, packed like rows of cursed text. The marks form an all-over inscription rather than a single band.

entries.id: CO 40 Feranas Right Foot L1 Female
entries.label: CO  40  Feranas Right Foot L 1  Female

layers.texture: Actors\Character\Overlays\Community Overlays\CO 2\40 Body Right Leg L1 F.dds

tags.subject: single-foot swirl tendril
tags.placement: top of the right foot, ankle and outer instep

entries.description: A single-foot design only, on the right foot: a long hooked tendril with a coiled spiral terminal rises from the toes up the instep and wraps the outer ankle. The left foot is left bare.

entries.id: CO 40 Feranas Right Foot L2 Female
entries.label: CO  40  Feranas Right Foot L 2  Female

layers.texture: Actors\Character\Overlays\Community Overlays\CO 2\40 Body Right Leg L2 F.dds

tags.subject: single-foot swirl tendril, denser variant
tags.placement: top of the right foot, ankle, outer instep and toes

entries.description: A single-foot design only, on the right foot: a denser stack of tribal curls climbs from the toes over the instep and wraps the outer ankle, with multiple interlocking coiled spirals and hook-tipped tendrils. Reads as a thicker tier of the same motif.

entries.id: CO 40 Feranas Right Foot L3 Female
entries.label: CO  40  Feranas Right Foot L 3  Female

layers.texture: Actors\Character\Overlays\Community Overlays\CO 2\40 Body Right Leg L3 F.dds

tags.subject: dotted vine outline
tags.placement: top of the right foot, ankle and outer instep

entries.description: A single-foot mark only, on the right foot: a faint dotted outline of the L2 tendril, rendered as tiny stipple dots that climb from the toes up the instep and around the outer ankle. Reads as a faded scar of the heavier design.

entries.label: CO  48  Faeri Feet Female

tags.subject: filigree ankle band with central scroll
tags.placement: ankles, outer foot edges and a central scroll over the instep

entries.description: A narrow filigree band wraps each ankle and trails along the outer edge of the foot, with a small ornate scroll-and-curl cluster centred on the instep of each foot. Made of paired curls, tiny diamond accents and coiled scrolls, reading as etched jewellery.

entries.label: CO  49  Azaer Tribe Feet Female

tags.subject: dense interlocked maze-glyph
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles, toes and inner arch

entries.description: A heavy all-over maze of interlocked thick-line knotwork covers the top of each foot, the ankle and the toes, with the densest convolutions over the instep. Stylised mask-like faces appear in the negative spaces, giving a primal tribal-armour look.
